tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The cream sheet everything is laid on: the page background, lit from the centre. Ground for ink.

tokens.name: desk-2
tokens.usage: The sheet's darker rim, where the radial vignette behind desk ends.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Plain paper: session rows, search fields, filters, step lists, paper buttons. Ground for ink and mute.

tokens.name: sheet-warm
tokens.usage: The chat sheet: the big paper behind the tab row and the thread.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The whitest paper: the leaf laid over the tabs, the composer card, the selected chat tab.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Inner paper inside a leaf: capsule bodies and popovers.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Tinted paper: code chips, key caps, the slot of a switch, a disabled control.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A hovered row or filter.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The cardboard face: the rail, the sessions board, the cardboard button. Fluted with flute hairlines every 3px.

tokens.name: board-2
tokens.usage: Cardboard's cut edge, 2 to 3px along the bottom and right, and the board's border.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Kraft paper: inactive chat tabs, folder tabs, the kraft paper button.

tokens.name: kraft-2
tokens.usage: Kraft's cut edge, and the face of an uncoloured sticker (glyphs only in paper: white reads 2.9:1 on it).

tokens.name: mat-green
tokens.usage: The sage cardboard mat under a capsule deck and the sage confirm button. Ground for ink (6.3:1).

tokens.name: mat-green-2
tokens.usage: The sage mat's cut edge and border.

tokens.name: mat-red
tokens.usage: The terracotta cardboard frame around the composer. Never a text ground.

tokens.name: mat-red-2
tokens.usage: The terracotta frame's cut edge.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy, titles and labels on desk and every paper; the pencil focus ring.

tokens.name: mute
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, hand-written counts and durations on sheet, sheet-warm and card (5.3:1 in paper, 6:1 in night).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and hairline marks only (2.9:1 on sheet): never body copy.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dashed rules and dividers printed on paper.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The blue-grey ruled lines printed on a note.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Idle effort bars and the dashed outline of a printed button.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Glyphs and labels printed on a coloured sticker. Never a surface.

tokens.name: sticker-cut
tokens.usage: The die-cut border around every sticker, 1.5 to 2px. Always with no shadow.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The paw mark, the memory sticker, number badges, the busy pill. White glyphs on it read 4.4:1 in paper and 3.3:1 in night, so keep it to glyphs and bold badges.

tokens.name: red-2
tokens.usage: The pull-requests sticker and the destructive sticker button: white reads 7.7:1 in paper, 5.8:1 in night.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The sessions sticker, the primary sticker button, the switch knob when on, the hand-written link. Carries on-blue.

tokens.name: blue-2
tokens.usage: The agents sticker and blue's cut edge.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Label on a blue sticker: white in paper (6.7:1), ink in night (5.4:1).

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The MCPs sticker, the idle pill, the Done chip. White glyphs read 3.9:1 in paper: glyphs and hand-written chips only.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The skills and background stickers, the pinwheel, busy durations. White glyphs read 3.5:1 in paper: glyphs only.

tokens.name: max
tokens.usage: The workspaces sticker and the MAX stamp.

tokens.name: max-2
tokens.usage: The MAX stamp's paper.

tokens.name: kind-think
tokens.usage: The workflows sticker and thinking kind dots.

tokens.name: kind-sub
tokens.usage: The kanban sticker and subagent kind dots.

tokens.name: attn
tokens.usage: The gold ring around a selected sticker (sticker-on), the attention badge, the needs-you button. Carries on-attn.

tokens.name: on-attn
tokens.usage: Ink on an attn sticker (9:1).

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: A selected row, filter or paper button: paper gone yellow under a marker. Ground for ink.

tokens.name: highlighter-2
tokens.usage: The highlighted paper's cut edge.

tokens.name: tape
tokens.usage: Tape strips pinning a note to the sheet.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Paper's cut edge: the 1px solid offset under rows, filters, fields and paper buttons.

tokens.name: edge-2
tokens.usage: A thicker paper's cut edge, 2px: the chat sheet, the leaf, the composer card.

tokens.name: amb
tokens.usage: The cast shadow under cardboard and paper, down and to the right. Never under a sticker.

tokens.name: amb-2
tokens.usage: The far, soft shadow under the tallest pieces: boards, the leaf, the composer frame.

tokens.name: face
tokens.usage: Top of the face gradient on every cut piece, fading to clear at 55%: the light from the top left.

tokens.name: gloss
tokens.usage: Top of the gloss on a sticker, fading to clear at 55%.

tokens.name: flute
tokens.usage: The corrugation hairlines across cardboard: 1px every 3px.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a popover.

styles.name: said
styles.sample: Local cards render markdown, but synced cards show plain text.
styles.usage: The agent's narration written in the margin of the sheet.

styles.name: cover
styles.usage: The system's name on the cover only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Run the suite on main and report the failing cases.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, rows, filters, tab names: anything set in a strip of paper or on a sticker.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Small buttons, step lists, kbd hints.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Number badges and the busy pill (uppercase, 0.06em tracking).

styles.name: hand
styles.usage: Counts, durations, placeholders and the hand-written link button, in mute or blue.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: The Done chip and any hand-written sticker.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code chips and key caps on paper-2.

spacing.note: The diorama uses the values it needs. Names are the pixel value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The cut-edge height of cardboard (horizontal) and the small sticker cut.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: The desk margin around the whole diorama; the cut-edge height of cardboard (vertical); the flute pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap under the paw; the badge's overhang.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chat tabs, between stickers, inside a button between icon and label.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between rail stickers, inside rows and fields; tab top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Padding inside a 44px rail sticker; horizontal padding of rows, filters and the sessions board's gap to the rail.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Rail top padding, the sheet's gap to the board, horizontal padding of a button.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a chat tab and a cardboard button; the composer's foot padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a large button; gap between groups on a sheet.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Content padding on the leaf.

radius.note: Cardboard and stickers are cut round. Paper is cut nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Code chips, key caps, the square workspace dot.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Session rows and small paper buttons.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Fields, filters, paper buttons; the leaf's top corners.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: The workspace folder header.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: The cardboard button.

tokens.name: radius-7
tokens.usage: The top corners of a chat tab.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Sticker buttons.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: A sage mat.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Cardboard boards, the chat sheet, the leaf's bottom corners, rail icon stickers, the terracotta frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, chips, the switch.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Badges, dots, the pinwheel, round stickers and round icon buttons.

shadow.note: Every cast shadow is a solid cut edge plus one soft shadow down and to the right. Stickers get a cut border and no shadow.

tokens.name: lift-paper-1
tokens.usage: A strip of paper on the desk or on a board: rows, filters, fields, paper buttons, step lists.

tokens.name: lift-paper-2
tokens.usage: Paper lifted a step: a hovered row, a hovered paper button, the selected row.

tokens.name: lift-paper-3
tokens.usage: The tallest paper: the chat sheet and the leaf laid over the tabs.

tokens.name: lift-board
tokens.usage: Cardboard: the rail and the sessions board.

tokens.name: lift-board-sm
tokens.usage: A small piece of cardboard: the cardboard button at rest.

tokens.name: lift-mat
tokens.usage: The sage mat under a capsule deck and the sage confirm button.

tokens.name: lift-frame
tokens.usage: The terracotta frame around the composer.

tokens.name: press-paper
tokens.usage: A paper button while pressed: it sits down on the desk.

tokens.name: press-board
tokens.usage: A cardboard button while pressed, after travelling 2px right and 3px down.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: The die-cut border of a sticker 30px and up: rail icons, sticker buttons, the pill. No cast shadow.

tokens.name: sticker-s
tokens.usage: The die-cut border of a small sticker: badges, chips, dots, the pinwheel, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: sticker-on
tokens.usage: A selected sticker: the white cut, then a gold ring. The active rail icon, an on sticker toggle.

tokens.name: recess
tokens.usage: A piece set into another: the composer card inside its frame, the slot of a switch.

tilt.note: Only stickers tilt. Paper and cardboard lie straight.

tokens.name: tilt-logo
tokens.usage: The paw mark at the top of the rail.

tokens.name: tilt-sticker-on
tokens.usage: A selected rail sticker (with scale 1.08).

tokens.name: tilt-hover
tokens.usage: A hovered sticker button or icon sticker.

tokens.name: tilt-badge
tokens.usage: Number badges on rail stickers.

tokens.name: tilt-badge-row
tokens.usage: Number badges on session rows.

tokens.name: tilt-chip
tokens.usage: The Done chip.

tokens.name: tilt-row-on
tokens.usage: The selected session row (highlighted paper).

tokens.name: tilt-cat
tokens.usage: The cat peeking over the composer.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Paper borders (rgba black at 7%), dashed rules in line, flute hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-mat
tokens.usage: Mat and frame borders; the dashed outline of a printed button (bar).

tokens.name: stroke-cut-s
tokens.usage: The die-cut border of a small sticker.

tokens.name: stroke-cut
tokens.usage: The die-cut border of a sticker; the pencil focus ring in ink.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: The gold ring outside the cut of a selected sticker.

tokens.name: stroke-tab
tokens.usage: The red top edge of the selected chat tab.

tokens.name: stroke-frame
tokens.usage: The terracotta frame's width around the composer card.

motion.note: Quick and smooth. Stickers scale and tilt; paper and cardboard travel; nothing pulses.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Anything that moves or appears: lifts, presses, drops, opening and closing.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Anything that lands: a sticker being stuck on, a stamp.

tokens.name: ease-io
tokens.usage: The gentle loops while the agent works, always with alternate.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover lifts, presses, tints.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Pieces dropping in, popovers.

tokens.name: dur-land
tokens.usage: Stickers and stamps landing.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: The pinwheel's turn and the working loops.
